summary: Re-tested Iteration49 scope for backend + frontend. All requested checks passed: pytest 10/10, local credentialed CORS on localhost:8001, 3-attempt lockout policy, ledger option warning regression, expenses new categories, and setup EXE integrity/size.

Keep local CORS preflight verification on localhost:8001 in regression checks to avoid Cloudflare/edge header noise.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains a large monolithic file (>700 lines), which increases regression risk for future accounting/auth changes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated with public app URL from frontend/.env for user-visible flows, and localhost:8001 for true app-level CORS preflight. Local preflight returned explicit origin + Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true for both preview origin and http://localhost:3000. Playwright login->/ledger->/expenses check confirmed no invalid <option> hydration warning and presence of categories: حج وعمرة/قسط لحوم/لجنة نقابية. /api/download/setup returned MZ binary and matched local dist size (16930222).
rca of the issue: No failing issue reproduced in this retest scope. Note: public edge headers can differ from app CORS behavior, so localhost verification is the reliable source for credentialed preflight.
